defects.statement: a deployment whose rollback fails (or whose rollback health re-check fails) leaves the deployment journal in ROLLING_BACK; GetActiveDeployments() selects every row whose phase is not DONE, so the next Agent start replays that stale rollback and writes the old backup over whatever version is currently installed
triggers_observed_here: AR-32/case SYS-53 permission seam: AtomicReplace fails with EPERM (chattr +i), rollback fails the same way and reports "rollback failed"; after the child restart the stale backup overwrote the successfully deployed version (Desired != Actual)

SYS-48 non-systemd negative health branches (tcp/http/command): rollback() restores the files and then re-runs the health check of the FAILED version, which can never pass, so the journal stays ROLLING_BACK; the next start rewrote the binary path with the newest stale backup (mtime changed) and closed the rows to DONE
code_pointers: internal/agent/application.go:395-407 (failed(): ROLLING_BACK only closes to DONE when rollback succeeds)
internal/agent/application.go:673-678 (rollback() finishes with checkHealth(hc) using the failed version health definition)
internal/agent/application.go:729-739 (RecoverDeployments re-runs rollback for every non-PREPARING row)

verified_dimensions.seam: the owned child Agent runs as root, so DAC mode bits cannot deny the write; the real permission seam is chattr +i on the owned binary directory (EPERM), same as sys-b11 SYS-52

denied_deploy.block_reason: install binary failed: open /opt/qa-papp-f7821a1dbfb5/app/bin/.tmp-2812476608: operation not permitted; rollback failed

AR-32.failure_summary: the denied deploy reports "install binary failed ... operation not permitted; rollback failed" and leaves the deployment journal in ROLLING_BACK; after a child restart RecoverDeployments replays that row and writes the stale backup over the currently installed (successfully deployed) version, so Desired != Actual

INV-11.title: Managed Application 必须存在恢复路径
open_items: recovery after a FAILED rollback is broken: the journal stays in ROLLING_BACK and is replayed at the next start, writing that row stale backup over the current version (E2E-20261014-ROLLBACK-FAILED-STALE-BACKUP-RESTORE); AR-32 shows the user-visible variant where Desired != Actual afterwards

non-systemd health-check failures also leave ROLLING_BACK rows (E2E-20261014-ROLLBACK-FAILED-STALE-BACKUP-RESTORE); on the next start the recovery rewrote the binary path (mtime changed) with the newest stale backup and closed every row to DONE - here byte-identical to the installed version, so no version change was user-visible
